checklist.detail: NARloy-Z Copper Alloy (Cu-Ag-Zr): computed wall temp 816 K EXCEEDS its 800 K max service temp (Tc 3520 K, regenerative cooling). Marginal/unsuitable as designed. Basis: coupled throat wall balance: gas h_g ~18.2 kW/m2K, coolant ~103 m/s (h_c ~88.1 kW/m2K, coolant-side wall ~619 K), 1.50 mm wall. Levers that lower it: faster coolant (Coolant velocity; SP-8087 caps liquids at ~61 m/s, at a jacket-dP cost), a thinner wall, a liner rated hotter or more conductive (e.g. GRCop-84), or more film cooling.

checklist.detail: Resultant injection beta angle +5.3 deg is outside the -4 to +2 deg band LOX/LH2 prefers - it wants a slightly negative beta (~0 or below). Adjust the impingement angle or element momentum ratio.
checklist.name: Injector resultant beta angle

checklist.detail: First tangential mode ~2867 Hz is in the band damaging instability lives in (<4000 Hz) and the injector is soft (dP/Pc 0.15 < 0.18). Historically this regime needed an odd-compartment injector-face baffle or corner-mounted Helmholtz cavities. Stiffen the injector, or plan on damping devices.
checklist.name: Combustion acoustic-mode margin

checklist.detail: Near the end of active cooling (area ratio ~77.5), estimated jacket/coolant pressure (~24.2 MPa) exceeds local hot-gas static pressure (~0.0 MPa) - the net load on the channel-land wall there REVERSES direction. Modeled as a clamped-strip bending stress across the ~20.6 mm channel width, this reversed ~24.2 MPa differential is ~20650 MPa against a ~67 MPa allowable (Stainless Steel (304/316), SF 1.5) - but this is a coarse clamped-plate-strip proxy, NOT a real buckling/FEA analysis, and this codebase has no real-engine spot check for it yet. Treat this as 'worth a closer structural look', not a validated failure prediction. Consider more/narrower channels (smaller span), tapering the actively-cooled length, or a thicker wall there.
checklist.name: Jacket overpressure vs. channel-wall structural margin
